## Spec

A component writes this trait's fields under `spec.networkPolicy`.

```cue
spec: networkPolicy: #NetworkPolicySchema

#NetworkPolicySchema: {
	// Which directions this policy governs. Naming a direction with no matching
	// rule DENIES all traffic in that direction — "Egress" with no `egress`
	// entries is a deny-all-egress policy, not a no-op.
	policyTypes: [...("Ingress" | "Egress")] | *["Ingress"]

	ingress?: [...#NetworkPolicyIngressRule]
	egress?: [...#NetworkPolicyEgressRule]
}

// An empty rule (`{}`) means "allow all in this direction" — the idiom istiod
// uses for egress, because features like JWKS resolution need to reach
// user-defined endpoints.
#NetworkPolicyIngressRule: {
	ports?: [...#NetworkPolicyPort]
	from?: [...#NetworkPolicyPeer]
}

#NetworkPolicyEgressRule: {
	ports?: [...#NetworkPolicyPort]
	to?: [...#NetworkPolicyPeer]
}

#NetworkPolicyPort: {
	protocol?: "TCP" | "UDP" | "SCTP"
	port?:     int & >=1 & <=65535
	endPort?:  int & >=1 & <=65535
}

#NetworkPolicyPeer: {
	podSelector?: {...}
	namespaceSelector?: {...}
	ipBlock?: {
		cidr!: string
		except?: [...string]
	}
}
```

## Notes

Renders a NetworkPolicy that selects the workload's pods.

## Served by

These transformers in `opmodel.dev/catalogs/opm@v4` version `4.5.0` require this trait or read it when present.

| Transformer | Demand | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `daemonset-transformer` | optional | Converts daemon workload components to Kubernetes DaemonSets |
| `deployment-transformer` | optional | Converts stateless workload components with Container resource to Kubernetes Deployments |
| `network-policy-transformer` | required | Converts the NetworkPolicy trait to a Kubernetes NetworkPolicy selecting the workload's pods |
| `statefulset-transformer` | optional | Converts stateful workload components to Kubernetes StatefulSets |
